g.text: 481 tests in 20 modules; bar length is test count, not coverage of behaviour
62 tests assert nothing but raise, 15 of them in the contract module, and only 68 of 481 carry a docstring,
so behaviour has to be read from the body. Two fail away from Windows: launcher identity is ntpath and
PowerShell. And no test reaches the UI at all, which is why the hook-order crash survived until the review.
Counts come from parsing backend/tests on 2026-10-30; they describe size, not defensibility.
